answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. The pearl opens the gate, the dawn pays the toll, the mesa proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Every applicant faces the same trial, Shirt maker silk gown mark sewn into the tailor's shop, and every verdict reads the same way: each silk gown is a year of sewing logs in the cloth ledger. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 31 per proof, 17267 for 557, owed every epoch with no exception.
